positions.statement: The Oregon Capital Chronicle reported in August 2026, citing a news release from House candidate Tammy Carpenter, that Neron Misslin is one of four Democratic lawmakers who will propose a three-year moratorium on new data centers in the 2027 session.
positions.excerpt: State Sens. Jeff Golden, D-Ashland, and Courtney Neron Misslin, D-Wilsonville, and state Reps. Lesly Muñoz, D-Woodburn, and Farrah Chaichi, D-Beaverton, will propose the moratorium during the 2027 legislative session that begins in January

source.publisher: Jefferson Public Radio, republishing Oregon Capital Chronicle (Alex Baumhardt)

verification.note: Corrected. Article (Oregon Capital Chronicle, Alex Baumhardt, 2026-08-04, via JPR) says Neron Misslin and three other Democratic lawmakers "will propose the moratorium during the 2027 legislative session", per a Monday news release from House candidate Tammy Carpenter. She is not quoted. Old statement only said she was "involved"; reworded to say what the article reports, attributed to the release, and excerpt widened to include the verb.
